testcase.name: REV-STRUCT-01 [3.2, 12.1, NFR-02, NFR-03] single-file offline constraints are observable
REV-FR01-01 [FR-01] user controls follow Idle → Running → Paused → Idle and absolute time advances
REV-FR01-02 [FR-01, BR-03] reset does not consume an already completed Focus slot
REV-FR02-01 [FR-02, EC-01] granted notification permission triggers sound and browser notification together
REV-FR02-02 [FR-02, EC-01] unsupported notification and failed audio use the title fallback
REV-FR03-01 [FR-03, FR-05, BR-04] Focus completion records before memo resolution and starts Short Break after submission
REV-FR03-02 [FR-03, BR-01] Break expiry starts Focus without showing memo UI
REV-FR03-03 [FR-03, BR-01] consuming the fourth Focus slot selects Long Break
REV-FR04-01 [FR-04, BR-01] skipping Focus advances the slot without changing completion count or requesting memo
REV-FR04-02 [FR-04, BR-01] two skipped Focus slots plus two timed completions reach Long Break with count two
REV-FR05-01 [FR-05] blank submission is accepted and displayed as no memo
REV-FR06-01 [FR-06] selected day shows the saved count and chronological memo order
REV-FR07-01 [FR-07] invalid duration inputs are rejected and Idle settings update immediately
REV-FR07-02 [FR-07] Running and Paused sessions retain their current timing while settings change
REV-FR08-01 [FR-08, EC-03, 13.2] Running state restores with its absolute end time after reload
REV-FR08-02 [FR-08, EC-03, 13.2] Paused state restores the same positive snapshot after offline time
REV-EC03-01 [EC-03, BR-02] an expired restored Focus is completed once and waits for memo interaction
REV-EC02-01 [EC-02] a hidden tab defers expiry until visibilitychange and then reconciles by target time
REV-EC04-01 [EC-04, NFR-01, 13.3-U4] a five-second-or-greater wall/performance delta pauses at the last valid display and offers resume
REV-EC05-01 [EC-05, 13.3-U5] write failure keeps timer usable and a later successful write clears the warning
REV-NFR01-01 [NFR-01, 13.3-U3] a long elapsed interval is derived from wall time without countdown drift
REV-13.2-01 [13.2 System Acceptance] one foreground flow connects start, expiry, memo, break, next Focus, and log
REV-13.3-U1 [13.3 User Acceptance] a timed user session produces the matching daily log including a blank memo
REV-13.3-U2 [13.3 User Acceptance] settings, running timer, and log data survive a reload boundary
